_comment: THE rhabdo-safety file. caps[cap_key][phase] is the maximum number of reps of that movement bucket allowed in a SINGLE session for that phase. 0 means the movement is not allowed in a WOD at that phase at all (technique/accessory use aside). weekly_ramp_pct caps how much total weekly volume of any one bucket may grow week-over-week. These numbers are deliberately conservative for a returning athlete with a prior rhabdo episode; raise them slowly and only with good reason. The engine treats these as a hard ceiling that nothing downstream can exceed.
